# Bundled front-end libraries

All three are MIT licensed. Each library's licence text sits next to its files and is copied
into `<title>_assets/lib/<name>/` by mkgallery. Files are unmodified except where noted.

## jquery — jQuery 3.7.1
- Homepage: https://jquery.com
- Files: `jquery.min.js` (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.7.1/jquery.min.js),
  `LICENSE.txt` (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jquery/jquery/3.7.1/LICENSE.txt)

## justifiedgallery — Justified Gallery 3.8.1
- Homepage: https://github.com/miromannino/Justified-Gallery
- Files from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/justifiedGallery@3.8.1: `dist/js/jquery.justifiedGallery.min.js`,
  `dist/css/justifiedGallery.min.css`, `LICENSE`

## glightbox — GLightbox 3.3.0
- Homepage: https://github.com/biati-digital/glightbox
- Files from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/glightbox@3.3.0: `dist/js/glightbox.min.js`,
  `dist/css/glightbox.min.css`, `LICENSE.md`
- Modification: a one-line copyright/licence banner was prepended to `glightbox.min.js`
  (the upstream minified file ships without one).
